preconditions.description: Number of cities being attacked (m) and total number of cities (n) are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.
There are exactly n - 1 roads connecting the cities.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= city <= n for city in attacked_cities)
preconditions.description: All attacked cities are within the range of 1 to n.
The number of attacked cities matches the given m.

postconditions.description: The teleport city is within the range of 1 to n.
The minimum time needed is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(min_time >= sum(distances[teleport_city][city] for city in attacked_cities))
postconditions.description: The minimum time is at least the sum of distances from the teleport city to each attacked city.

postconditions.expression: any(all(min_time == sum(distances[city][other_city] for other_city in attacked_cities) for city in attacked_cities) for city in attacked_cities)
postconditions.description: There exists at least one city such that the sum of distances from that city to each attacked city equals the minimum time.
